args.name: moss-prepared-root-placement
args.function: Provide a learnable, bounded root-placement trial personally applicable to Moss's cleared prepared surface surface-38-moss-234. Examine current clearance and substrate compatibility before allowing placement of one owned fresh root; report specific incompatibility if placement is not supported.
args.conditions: Tick-70 paid diagnostic found no observed obstruction, zero source cover and residue, and 0.04 conserved litter mass in the separate deposit. Ordinary placement remains ineligible; existing prepared-surface-root-placement is bound to Lin and another surface. Require actual reach, current unoccupied geometry, personal learning and suitable real input. Do not bypass these checks.
args.inputs: At most one owned fresh root for placement; none currently owned. Examination should not consume a root. No use of the nonharvestable litter as input.
args.costs: Method and costs are unknown; specify finite learning and execution costs, reservation rules, interruption and cancellation behavior before use.
args.effects: A dated compatibility finding and, only after learning and valid paid execution with actual material, one bounded root placement. No promised viability, propagation, food yield or wellbeing benefit; no automatic execution or permission grant.

candidates.function: Examine Moss surface-38-moss-234 and its conserved residue links to distinguish observed obstruction, uncertainty and unsupported placement applicability.
candidates.costs: One study round and 0.2 energy; each valid atomic examination costs one round and 0.5 energy, with no root or material input/output. Invalid identity, scope, reach or energy does not charge.
candidates.effects: Private dated report of actual visible geometry, complete conserved source data and implementation applicability. No planting, clearing, resource, reservation, mastery, viability or wellbeing grant. Repeating pays again without reward. No ongoing process or maintenance; cancel/interruption/death before execution has no completed finding; after completion, finding and paid effort persist without refund. Only actual communication can share knowledge.

candidates.function: Physically examine one reachable x/y footprint and report visible surface evidence plus provisional compatibility with the existing root-placement operation.
candidates.costs: One completed round and 0.5 energy after valid visible reach and bounds checks. No material, tools, plot or reservation. Invalid invocations do not begin or charge. A later new examination pays again.
candidates.effects: Private dated surface/clearance findings identify operation limitations separately from unknown physical properties. Bare ground is distinct from the general ordinary-soil moisture regime. No deeper substrate, concealed occupant or hidden resource information. No clearing, excavation, sampling, planting, material change, skill grant, food or reward. The atomic attempt has no resumable work or maintenance; no unperformed completion is recorded. Results are not silently refreshed and sharing requires real communication.

candidates.function: Examine a nominated prepared surface and, only if feasible, place one real root through the existing paid trial operation.
candidates.costs: Study1 round/0.2 energy. Examine(preparedSurfaceId) costs1 round/0.5 energy. Plant additionally requires personal root-planting-trial mastery; its first round examines and reserves one unspoiled root, followed by two1-energy work rounds. This version is bound to Lin, surface-21-lin-113 and owned root item-3-lin-12. Valid visible access within0.65 plus body radius is required. Resume/cancel need exact processId. No other inputs supplied.
candidates.effects: Checks real cover, residue extents, people, obstacles, reservations, ground matter and access. The clear non-solid annotation alone is not matter. Live conflicts pause before further payment. Exact root escrow and paid progress persist; cancel/death releases surviving unplanted root on the actual worksite ground once, never remote inventory. Successful commitment links the existing surface to one actual trial plot; completed placement cannot be cancelled into food. Existing ageing continues. No propagation, growth, harvest, fertility, free soil removal, food output, maintenance, reward or viability guarantee. Private dated evidence only; the30-round observation remains inconclusive.

candidates.function: Examine one nominated radius-0.2 footprint, then attempt at most two rounds of manual loose-cover displacement, conserving debris inside the original boundary.
candidates.costs: Fresh start: one round and 0.5 energy for feasibility. Up to two additional work rounds cost one energy each. Radius is fixed at 0.2; x/y bind the job and cannot be substituted. No tool, root, water, food or inventory material is given or consumed.
candidates.effects: Supports explicitly modeled loose forest-floor cover only. Each supported footprint begins with finite 0.04 cover mass units, with hand capacity 0.02 per work round. All displaced matter remains non-food non-harvestable residue inside the boundary. Repeated attempts reuse actual remaining cover/residues, never reset quantities. Partial changes persist; cancel/death closes only the work lock, without restoration or refund. Entire-footprint root eligibility remains false while any cover or residue remains; exhausting work does not prove suitable soil. No unattended work, regrowth suppression, planting, food, moisture/fertility improvement or reward. Study and surface changes are separate.

Repeated starts inspect live remaining mass, never reset it.

candidates.function: Place owned moss, inspect the resulting arrangement or perform a real ground-supported contact/rest trial.
candidates.costs: Quote: retrieve this ability through the free control abilities query; reading these exact terms takes no world round. Begin requires inputStackId, quantity 0.1–2 in tenths, x/y and radius 0.1–0.5, two actual rounds at 1 energy each. Study costs two rounds at 0.2 energy. Inspect requires arrangementId, one round/0.2 energy. Rest-trial requires arrangementId and actual contact position, one baseline rest round, with existing mental/facility factors and cap40. Resume/cancel use exact processId. Additional placement on an owned unlocked arrangement repeats the same costs and exact footprint.
candidates.effects: First step places actual reserved moss at the site; second spreads actual tenths within the nominated radius, without mass-to-volume or coverage inference. Placed ground material is recoverable with recover(arrangementId), one round/0.5 energy for actual reachable surviving portions; this scoped pickup supports tenths that baseline whole-unit pickup cannot. Recovery removes material from the arrangement. Cancel/death preserve placed material and paid work; no refund or automatic labor. Rest measures real geometric contact and at most0.02 lateral displacement of contacted loose material inside the footprint; no inferred load strength, thickness, comfort, durability or recovery bonus. Usability remains inconclusive. Personal findings are not publicly shared. No reward, regeneration, binding, tool or stock grant.

candidates.function: Prepare a small soil patch and place one real root unit for a persistent observation trial; resume or cancel unfinished work.
candidates.costs: Plant: one owned unspoiled root unit; two work rounds at one energy each. Supply inputStackId and an unoccupied ordinary-soil x/y patch within 0.65 plus body radius. Resume/cancel use personal processId (omitting it selects the sole unfinished job). No tools or water are granted.
candidates.effects: Preparation and exact escrow persist when other actions interrupt work. Resume pays only remaining work. Cancel releases surviving unplanted material once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort and spoiled material are never refunded. Completed plots retain the real reserved root while existing environmental ageing runs. Reinspect with baseline probe: 30 elapsed rounds mark an inconclusive observation interval, not maturity or inferred death. There is no propagation, tending or harvest rule in this precursor, and no reward for placing it. Genuine observed changes can use existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback. Other people can observe the actual plot; execution requires personal study.
